Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/security/service/SecurityDefenseService.java only.
- Autowire IpRateLimitRecordRepository, AccountLockoutRecordRepository.
- Methods:
  * checkRateLimit(String ipAddress, String endpointGroup, int maxRequestsPerMinute): returns true if within limit, throws ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, 'Rate limit exceeded') if blocked.
  * recordFailedLogin(Long userId): increments failedAttempts. If >= 5, locks account for 15 minutes.
  * resetFailedLogins(Long userId): clears lockout record on successful login.
  * isAccountLocked(Long userId): returns boolean whether account is currently locked.
